lines: F
Excuse me, is this seat taken?
不好意思，这个座位有人吗？
c: Yes, I'll take it.
No, go ahead.
It's on the table.
ex: 问座位有没有人，“No, go ahead”表示没人、请坐。第二项把 taken 误解成“拿走”，第三项答非所问。

lines: M
Sorry I'm late. The bus didn't come.
抱歉我迟到了，公交车一直没来。
c: I'll take the bus, then.
Sorry, I'm late too.
That's OK. We just started.
ex: 对方道歉，应回答“没关系”。第二项重复 bus 一词，第三项把自己当成迟到的人，不合情境。

lines: F
Would you like some more tea?
要再来点茶吗？
c: No, thanks. I'm fine.
Yes, I like tea very much.
More than two cups.
ex: Would you like…? 是提供东西，回答“要/不要”。第二项把 would like 误听成 like（喜欢），第三项答非所问。

lines: M
How long does it take to get to the station from here?
从这里到车站要多长时间？
c: It's very long.
About ten minutes on foot.
Since last week.
ex: How long does it take 问花费的时间。第二项只抓住 long，第三项是回答 how long have you… 的说法。

lines: F
I can't believe I left my umbrella on the train again.
真不敢相信，我又把伞忘在地铁上了。
c: Yes, it's going to rain again.
Good idea. Let's take the train.
Oh no. Maybe you can call the lost and found.
cz: 哎呀，也许你可以给失物招领处打个电话。
ex: 对方抱怨又丢了伞，合适的回应是表示同情并给出建议。第二、三项只是重复了 again、train 等词。

lines: M
Do you mind if I open the window?
你介意我开窗吗？
c: Not at all. It's a bit stuffy in here.
Yes, please open it.
No, I don't have the key.
cz: 一点也不介意，这里有点闷。
ex: Do you mind…? 回答 Yes 表示“介意”，所以同意要说 Not at all。第二项是常见的语气误解，第三项答非所问。

lines: F
You look exhausted. Didn't you get any sleep last night?
你看起来累坏了，昨晚没睡觉吗？
c: Yes, I look great, thanks.
Hardly. I was up finishing my paper.
I'll get some at the supermarket.
cz: 是的，我看起来很好，谢谢。
几乎没睡，我熬夜写论文了。
ex: Hardly 表示几乎没睡，并说明原因。第二项与 exhausted 矛盾，第三项把 get some 误解成“买东西”。

lines: M
Shall we grab a bite after class?
下课后一起去吃点东西吧？
c: No, I haven't signed up for that class.
The class ends at three.
Sure, I'm starving.
ex: grab a bite 是“随便吃点东西”的口语说法，接受邀请说 Sure。后两项都只围绕 class 回答。

lines: F
I was wondering if you could cover my shift on Saturday.
不知道你周六能不能替我顶一下班。
c: I'd love to help, but I've got a family thing that day.
Sure, I'll buy a new cover for it.
Yes, I was wondering about that too.
cz: 我很想帮你，可那天我家里有事。
好的，我给它买个新套子。
ex: cover one's shift 意为“替人值班”，委婉拒绝并说明理由最自然。第二项把 cover 理解成“套子”，第三项机械重复 wondering。

lines: M
If I'd known the traffic would be this bad, I'd have taken the subway.
早知道堵成这样，我就坐地铁了。
c: Good thing you took the subway, then.
Tell me about it. We'll be lucky to make it by noon.
Yes, the traffic is never bad here.
cz: 可不是嘛，中午前能到就算走运了。
ex: 虚拟语气说明他实际上没坐地铁、正堵在路上，Tell me about it 表示深有同感。第二项误解了虚拟语气，第三项与事实矛盾。

lines: F
You're not seriously thinking of quitting, are you?
你不会真的在考虑辞职吧？
c: Don't worry, I'll think of a good one.
I quit smoking years ago.
Actually, I've given it a lot of thought.
cz: 别担心，我会想个好点子的。
其实我已经认真考虑很久了。
ex: 对方惊讶地确认是否要辞职，回答“其实已经认真考虑过了”表示确有此意。第二项误解了 thinking of，第三项把 quit 用在戒烟上。

lines: M
The report's due tomorrow, and I haven't even started on the conclusion.
报告明天就要交了，我连结论都还没开始写。
c: Want me to look over what you've got so far?
Great, so you've finished it already.
The conclusion was really surprising.
cz: 要我帮你看看你目前写的部分吗？
太好了，那你已经写完了。
ex: 对方着急报告没写完，主动提出帮忙最自然。第二项与“还没开始写结论”矛盾，第三项把 conclusion 当成已有的结果。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What will the woman buy?
lines: M
Are you going to the supermarket? Can you get some things for the party tonight?
你要去超市吗？能帮我买点今晚聚会用的东西吗？
F
Sure. What do you need?
好啊，要什么？
M
We need some juice and paper cups.
我们需要果汁和纸杯。
F
Paper cups? I think we still have some in the kitchen.
纸杯？我记得厨房里还有一些。
M
Oh, you're right. Then just juice. Oh, and a cake, too.
哦，对。那就只买果汁吧。啊，还有一个蛋糕。
F
Didn't your sister say she'd bring a cake?
你姐姐不是说她会带蛋糕来吗？
M
Yes, she did. I forgot. OK, juice and some ice, then.
对，她说过，我忘了。那就买果汁和冰块吧。
F
Got it. Juice and ice.
知道了，果汁和冰块。
q: What will the woman buy?
c: Juice and paper cups
Juice and a cake
Juice and ice
Paper cups and ice
ex: 最后男的说 juice and some ice。纸杯厨房里还有，蛋糕姐姐会带来，所以都不用买。

intro: Listen to the conversation between a mother and her son. What will the boy do first?
lines: F
Tom, are you going out to play soccer?
汤姆，你要出去踢足球吗？
M
Yes, Mom. The game starts at four.
是的，妈妈。比赛四点开始。
F
Did you finish your homework?
作业写完了吗？
M
Not yet. I'll do it after the game.
还没有，比赛完再写。
F
Hmm. Then at least clean your room before you go. It's a mess.
嗯……那出门前至少把房间收拾一下，乱成一团了。
M
But I'll be late!
可是我会迟到的！
F
It's only two thirty. You have plenty of time.
现在才两点半，你时间多着呢。
M
OK, OK. I'll do it now.
好吧好吧，我现在就收拾。
q: What will the boy do first?
c: Clean his room
Do his homework
Play soccer
Go shopping with his mother
ex: 妈妈让他出门前先收拾房间，他回答 I'll do it now。作业要等比赛后再写，踢球在收拾房间之后。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a library. What will the woman do next?
lines: F
Hi, I'd like to borrow these three books.
你好，我想借这三本书。
M
Sure. Can I see your library card?
好的，请出示一下借书证。
F
Oh, I left it at home. Can I use my student ID instead?
啊，我把它忘在家里了。可以用学生证代替吗？
M
Sorry, you need a library card. But you can make a new one at the front desk. It only takes five minutes.
抱歉，必须用借书证。不过你可以在服务台办一张新的，只要五分钟。
F
Oh, OK. Where's the front desk?
哦，好的。服务台在哪里？
M
Right by the main entrance.
就在正门旁边。
F
Thanks. I'll go there now.
谢谢，我现在就过去。
q: What will the woman do next?
c: Go home to get her library card
Show her student ID
Return three books
Get a new library card at the front desk
ex: 管理员说可以在服务台办新卡，女的说 I'll go there now。学生证不能用，她也没有回家拿卡。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a café. What will the man have?
lines: F
Hi, what can I get you?
你好，要点什么？
M
Can I have a large coffee, please?
请给我一杯大杯咖啡。
F
Sorry, our coffee machine is broken today. We have tea or hot chocolate.
抱歉，今天咖啡机坏了。我们有茶和热巧克力。
M
Oh, OK. Then a hot chocolate.
哦，好吧。那就热巧克力。
F
Large or small?
大杯还是小杯？
M
Hmm, small, please. And a sandwich.
嗯，小杯吧。再要一个三明治。
F
Sorry, we just sold the last sandwich. We have muffins.
抱歉，最后一个三明治刚卖完了。我们有松饼。
M
A muffin is fine.
松饼也行。
q: What will the man have?
c: A large coffee and a sandwich
A small hot chocolate and a muffin
A large hot chocolate and a muffin
A small tea and a sandwich
ex: 咖啡机坏了，他改点小杯热巧克力；三明治卖完了，改要松饼。

intro: Listen to the conversation between a student and her professor. What will the woman do first?
lines: F
Professor Lee, do you have a minute? It's about my term paper.
李教授，您有空吗？是关于我的学期论文的事。
M
Sure, Lisa. What's up?
当然，丽莎。什么事？
F
I was planning to write about online shopping, but I'm finding it hard to narrow down.
我打算写网购，但发现很难缩小范围。
M
That's a very broad topic. Why not focus on one group, say, college students?
这个题目太宽泛了。为什么不只关注一个群体，比如大学生呢？
F
That's a good idea. Should I start with a survey, then?
好主意。那我应该先做问卷调查吗？
M
Not yet. First, read a few articles to see what's already been done. Then design your survey.
先别急。先读几篇文章，看看别人已经做过哪些研究，然后再设计问卷。
F
OK. Could you recommend some?
好的，您能推荐几篇吗？
M
Check the reading list I posted online. Start with the two articles marked with a star.
看看我发在网上的阅读书目，先读标了星号的那两篇。
F
Great, I'll do that tonight.
太好了，我今晚就读。
q: What will the woman do first?
c: Design a survey for college students
Read the articles marked on the reading list
Change her topic to campus life
Interview students about online shopping
cz: 读阅读书目中标星的文章
ex: 教授说 First, read a few articles，并让她先读标星号的两篇。问卷要在读完文章之后再设计。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What will the man do next?
lines: M
I've found a hotel near the beach for our trip. It's a bit pricey, though.
我给我们的旅行找到一家海边的酒店，不过有点贵。
F
How about the one we stayed at last year?
去年我们住的那家怎么样？
M
I already checked. It's fully booked that weekend.
我查过了，那个周末订满了。
F
That's a shame. What about going the following weekend instead?
真可惜。那改成下一个周末去呢？
M
I can't. I've got a conference then.
不行，那时我有个会议。
F
Well, let's just book the beach one. We only do this once a year.
那就订海边那家吧，反正一年就这一次。
M
True. But let me see if they offer a discount for booking early. I'll call them now.
也是。不过我先问问提前预订有没有折扣，我现在就打电话。
F
Good idea. I'll ask my mom if she can feed the cat while we're away.
好主意。我去问问我妈，我们不在时她能不能帮忙喂猫。
q: What will the man do next?
c: Book the hotel they stayed at last year
Move the trip to the following weekend
Ask the woman's mother to feed the cat
Call the beach hotel about a discount
cz: 打电话问海边酒店有没有折扣
ex: 男的说 I'll call them now，询问提前预订的折扣。去年的酒店已订满，下周末他要开会，问妈妈喂猫的是女的。

intro: Listen to the conversation in an office. What will the woman do next?
lines: M
Jenny, the meeting with the clients has been moved up to ten.
珍妮，和客户的会议提前到十点了。
F
Ten? I haven't printed the handouts yet!
十点？我还没打印讲义呢！
M
Don't panic. The printer on our floor is out of order, but you can use the one downstairs.
别慌。我们这层的打印机坏了，不过你可以用楼下那台。
F
OK. Should I make twenty copies?
好的。要印二十份吗？
M
Only twelve clients are coming, so fifteen should be enough.
只来十二位客户，十五份就够了。
F
Got it. What about the projector?
明白了。那投影仪呢？
M
I'll take care of that. Just get the copies done.
我来弄。你只管把材料印好。
F
Thanks. I'm on my way.
谢谢，我这就去。
q: What will the woman do next?
c: Print fifteen copies downstairs
Fix the printer on her floor
Make twenty copies of the handouts
Set up the projector
ex: 本层打印机坏了，要用楼下的；份数从二十份改为十五份。投影仪由男的负责。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What will the woman do first?
lines: F
So, the landlord finally got back to me about the apartment.
房东终于回复我公寓的事了。
M
And? Did they accept your offer?
然后呢？他接受你的出价了吗？
F
Sort of. He'll lower the rent, but only if I sign a two-year lease.
算是吧。他愿意降房租，但前提是我签两年的租约。
M
Two years is a long commitment, especially with your job situation up in the air.
两年可不短，何况你的工作还没定下来。
F
That's what worries me. If I get the transfer to Chicago, I'd be stuck paying rent here.
我担心的就是这个。如果我被调到芝加哥，还得一直在这边付房租。
M
Can't you ask whether there's a clause that lets you break the lease if you relocate for work?
你不能问问有没有因工作调动可以提前解约的条款吗？
F
I could, but I'd rather know about the transfer first. My manager said she'd decide by Friday.
可以问，但我更想先知道调动的结果。经理说她周五前会决定。
M
Then hold off on signing. Just tell the landlord you need until Monday.
那就先别签。跟房东说你需要等到周一。
F
You're right. I'll email him right now before he offers it to someone else.
你说得对。我现在就给他发邮件，免得他租给别人。
q: What will the woman do first?
c: Sign the two-year lease
Ask her manager about the transfer
Ask the landlord to wait until Monday
Ask for a clause about breaking the lease
cz: 要求加入提前解约的条款
ex: 男的建议先别签约、告诉房东需要等到周一，女的说马上给房东发邮件。调动结果要等经理周五决定，解约条款她并不打算先问。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two conference organizers. What will the man do next?
lines: M
We've got a problem with the keynote speaker. Her flight's been cancelled because of the storm.
主讲嘉宾出问题了。因为暴风雨，她的航班取消了。
F
Oh no. The conference starts tomorrow morning. Is there any chance she can get another flight?
糟了，会议明天上午就开始了。她有可能改签别的航班吗？
M
The earliest one lands at noon, so she'd miss her slot.
最早的一班中午才落地，她会错过自己的时段。
F
Could we swap her talk with the afternoon panel?
能把她的演讲和下午的小组讨论对调吗？
M
I thought of that, but two of the panelists are leaving right after lunch.
我想过，但有两位讨论嘉宾午饭后就要走。
F
What about having her give the talk by video link?
那让她通过视频连线演讲呢？
M
That could work. She mentioned she'd be fine with that. I'd just need to make sure the hall's equipment can handle it.
这个可行，她说过她没问题。我只需要确认会场的设备能不能支持。
F
Then check with the technical team first, before we tell anyone else.
那在通知其他人之前，先去和技术团队确认。
M
Right. I'll head over to the hall and talk to them now.
好，我现在就去会场找他们谈。
q: What will the man do next?
c: Book the speaker a later flight
Swap the keynote with the afternoon panel
Talk to the technical team about the equipment
Announce the change to the participants
cz: 给嘉宾订晚一点的航班
把主旨演讲和下午的讨论对调
ex: 两人决定改为视频演讲，男的要先去会场和技术团队确认设备。改签会错过时段，对调因嘉宾要提前离开不可行，通知其他人要等确认之后。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a visa office. What will the woman do first?
lines: F
Hi, I'm here to apply for a student visa. I have an appointment at two.
你好，我来申请学生签证，约的是两点。
M
Let me see. Do you have your passport, your acceptance letter, and the application form?
我看看。你带护照、录取通知书和申请表了吗？
F
Yes, they're all here. And I printed out my bank statements, too.
都带了。我还打印了银行流水。
M
Thanks. Hmm, these statements only cover the last month. We need at least three months.
谢谢。嗯，这些流水只有最近一个月的，我们至少需要三个月的。
F
Oh, I didn't realize. Can I just show them on my phone?
哦，我不知道。我可以在手机上给您看吗？
M
I'm afraid we need printed copies, stamped by the bank.
恐怕我们需要银行盖章的纸质版。
F
The bank's just across the street. Could I go there and come back today?
银行就在街对面。我能去一趟今天再回来吗？
M
Sure, we're open until five. And your photo is over six months old, so you'll need a new one. There's a photo booth in the lobby downstairs.
可以，我们开到五点。另外你的照片已经超过六个月了，需要新照片。楼下大厅有自助拍照机。
F
The lobby, great. I'll do that first, then head to the bank.
在大厅啊，太好了。我先拍照，再去银行。
q: What will the woman do first?
c: Have a new photo taken
Get stamped bank statements
Show the statements on her phone
Fill in the application form
ex: 女的最后说 I'll do that first, then head to the bank，即先在楼下拍照，再去银行。手机出示不被接受，申请表已经带来了。

intro: Listen to the conversation at school. Why was the woman late for school?
lines: M
Hi, Amy. You're late today. Did you oversleep?
嗨，艾米，你今天迟到了。睡过头了吗？
F
No, I got up early.
没有，我起得很早。
M
Was the bus late again?
又是公交车晚点了？
F
No, I rode my bike today. But on the way, it got a flat tire.
不是，我今天骑自行车来的，可路上车胎瘪了。
M
Oh no. Did you take it to the bike shop?
哎呀，你把车送去车铺了吗？
F
No, it was closed. So I had to push it all the way here.
没有，车铺关门了，所以我只好一路推着车过来。
q: Why was the woman late for school?
c: She overslept.
Her bus was late.
She took her bike to the shop.
Her bike had a flat tire.
ex: 女的说路上车胎瘪了，只好推车过来。她没睡过头，也没坐公交，车铺关门了没有修车。

intro: Listen to the conversation. What time will they meet?
lines: F
Do you want to see the new movie on Saturday?
周六想去看那部新电影吗？
M
Sure. What time does it start?
好啊，几点开始？
F
There are shows at two and five.
两点和五点各有一场。
M
I have a piano lesson until three.
我三点前有钢琴课。
F
Then let's go to the five o'clock show. Let's meet at the station at four thirty.
那我们看五点那场吧。四点半在车站见。
M
Hmm, can we meet at four? I want to get some popcorn before the movie.
嗯，能四点见吗？我想看电影前买点爆米花。
F
OK, four it is.
好，那就四点。
q: What time will they meet?
c: At four thirty
At four o'clock
At five o'clock
At three o'clock
ex: 女的先提议四点半，男的想买爆米花改成四点，女的同意了。五点是电影开场时间，三点是钢琴课结束时间。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a doctor's office. What does the doctor think is causing the man's headache?
lines: F
Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
早上好，哪里不舒服？
M
I have a bad headache, doctor.
医生，我头疼得厉害。
F
Do you have a fever or a sore throat?
发烧或嗓子疼吗？
M
No fever, and my throat is fine.
没发烧，嗓子也没事。
F
How much are you sleeping?
你睡多久？
M
Not much. I've been studying for exams until two every night.
睡得不多。我每晚都复习考试到两点。
F
I think that's the reason. Try to go to bed before midnight. And drink plenty of water, too.
我想原因就在这里。尽量十二点前睡觉，也要多喝水。
q: What does the doctor think is causing the man's headache?
c: He has a fever.
He isn't getting enough sleep.
He has a sore throat.
He studies in a cold room.
ex: 男的每晚学习到两点，医生说 I think that's the reason，即睡眠不足。他没有发烧，嗓子也没问题。

intro: Listen to the conversation at a student housing office. Why does the woman want to change rooms?
lines: F
Excuse me, I'd like to ask about changing my dorm room.
打扰一下，我想咨询换宿舍的事。
M
Is something wrong with your roommate?
是跟室友有什么问题吗？
F
No, she's really nice. And the room itself is fine, though it's a bit small.
不是，她人很好。房间本身也还行，虽然有点小。
M
Then what's the problem?
那是什么问题呢？
F
It's right next to the elevator. People go up and down all night, and I can't sleep.
房间就在电梯旁边，整晚都有人上上下下，我睡不着。
M
I see. There's a room open on the fourth floor, at the end of the hall. It's quieter, but it's farther from the bathroom.
明白了。四楼走廊尽头有一间空房，比较安静，不过离卫生间远一些。
F
That's no problem at all.
那完全没问题。
q: Why does the woman want to change rooms?
c: She doesn't get along with her roommate.
Her room is too small.
Her room is far from the bathroom.
Her room is noisy at night.
ex: 女的说房间在电梯旁，整晚有人来往睡不着。室友很好，房间小她并不在意，离卫生间远说的是新房间。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two friends. What does the man like most about his new job?
lines: F
So how's the new job going?
新工作怎么样？
M
Pretty well. The pay's not much better than before, to be honest.
挺好的。说实话，工资没比以前高多少。
F
Oh? But you seem a lot happier.
是吗？可你看起来开心多了。
M
I am. The office is close to home, so I can walk to work. But what I really love is my team. Everyone helps each other out.
确实。办公室离家近，我可以走路上班。不过我最喜欢的是我的团队，大家都互相帮忙。
F
That makes a big difference.
那差别可大了。
M
It does. At my last job, I hardly talked to anyone all day.
是啊。上一份工作我一整天几乎不跟人说话。
q: What does the man like most about his new job?
c: The people he works with
The higher pay
Being able to walk to work
Talking to customers all day
ex: 男的说 what I really love is my team，最喜欢的是同事互相帮助。工资没高多少，走路上班只是优点之一。

intro: Listen to the phone call to a restaurant. Why is the man calling?
lines: F
Good evening, Bella Cucina. How can I help you?
晚上好，这里是贝拉厨房。有什么可以帮您？
M
Hi, I have a reservation for tonight at seven, under the name Wilson.
你好，我订了今晚七点的位子，名字是威尔逊。
F
Yes, Mr. Wilson, a table for four.
是的，威尔逊先生，四人桌。
M
Actually, that's why I'm calling. Two more friends are joining us. Is it possible to make it six?
其实我就是为这个打电话的。又有两个朋友要来，能改成六个人吗？
F
Let me check. Hmm, we don't have a table for six at seven, but there's one at eight.
我查一下。嗯，七点没有六人桌，八点有一张。
M
Eight is a bit late, but OK. We'll take it.
八点有点晚，不过行，就订这个吧。
F
Great. A table for six at eight o'clock.
好的，八点，六人桌。
q: Why is the man calling?
c: To cancel his reservation
To change his reservation to an earlier time
To add more people to his reservation
To book a table for tomorrow
ex: 男的说又有两个朋友要来，想改成六人。时间从七点改到八点是结果，而且是改晚不是改早。

intro: Listen to the announcement at a museum. Which part of the museum is closed today?
lines: F
Good morning, and welcome to the City Science Museum.
早上好，欢迎来到市科学博物馆。
F
We'd like to let you know that the space exhibition on the second floor is closed today for repairs. It will reopen tomorrow.
我们通知各位，二楼的太空展厅今天因维修关闭，明天重新开放。
F
However, the dinosaur hall and the new robot exhibition on the third floor are open as usual.
不过，恐龙馆和三楼新的机器人展照常开放。
F
The robot show will begin at eleven, and again at two in the afternoon.
机器人表演在十一点开始，下午两点还有一场。
F
Please also note that the café on the first floor will close early today, at three.
另外请注意，一楼咖啡厅今天提前到三点关门。
F
Thank you, and enjoy your visit.
谢谢，祝您参观愉快。
q: Which part of the museum is closed today?
c: The dinosaur hall
The robot exhibition
The space exhibition
The café on the first floor
ex: 广播说二楼太空展厅今天维修关闭。恐龙馆和机器人展照常开放，咖啡厅只是提前到三点关门。

intro: Listen to the conversation between two coworkers. Why did the woman turn down the job offer?
lines: M
I heard you turned down the offer from that consulting firm. I thought it was your dream job.
听说你拒绝了那家咨询公司的录用。我还以为那是你梦寐以求的工作。
F
In a way, it was. The salary was great, and they were even willing to let me work from home twice a week.
某种程度上是。薪水很高，他们甚至同意我每周在家办公两天。
M
So what was the catch? The commute?
那问题出在哪？通勤吗？
F
Not really; it's only forty minutes by train. It was more that, in the final interview, they told me I'd be traveling almost every week.
不是，坐火车才四十分钟。主要是终面时他们告诉我几乎每周都要出差。
M
Ah. With your dad's health the way it is...
啊，你爸爸身体那个样子……
F
Exactly. I need to be around. Maybe in a couple of years things will be different.
没错，我得在家附近。也许过几年情况会不一样。
M
That makes sense. Family comes first.
可以理解，家人最重要。
q: Why did the woman turn down the job offer?
c: It required too much travel.
The salary was too low.
The commute was too long.
She couldn't work from home.
ex: 女的说几乎每周都要出差，而父亲身体不好她需要留在身边。薪水很高，通勤只有四十分钟，公司也允许在家办公。

intro: Listen to the news report. Why is the festival being moved?
lines: M
Officials in the coastal town of Fairhaven announced yesterday that the summer music festival will be moved from the town beach to the city park.
海滨小镇费尔黑文的官员昨天宣布，夏季音乐节将从镇上的海滩移到市公园举办。
M
The festival has drawn visitors from across the region for over thirty years.
三十多年来，这个音乐节吸引了来自整个地区的游客。
M
Many residents assumed the change was due to rising costs, but the mayor explained that the real reason is the beach itself.
许多居民以为改变地点是因为费用上涨，但镇长解释说，真正的原因在于海滩本身。
M
Storms over the past two winters have washed away much of the sand, leaving too little space for the stage and the crowds.
过去两个冬天的风暴冲走了大量沙子，剩下的空间放不下舞台和人群。
M
The town plans to restore the beach, but the work won't be finished until next year.
镇上计划修复海滩，但工程要到明年才能完成。
M
Ticket prices, the mayor added, will remain the same.
镇长还补充说，票价将保持不变。
q: Why is the festival being moved?
c: The cost of holding it has risen.
Ticket prices are going up.
The town wants to attract more visitors.
Storms have left the beach with too little space.
ex: 镇长说真正的原因是风暴冲走了沙子，海滩放不下舞台和人群。费用上涨只是居民的猜测，票价不变，吸引游客是音乐节过去的情况。

intro: Listen to the conversation about a study. According to the woman, what was the main finding of the study?
lines: F
Did you read that study on remote work that came out last week?
你读了上周发表的那项关于远程办公的研究吗？
M
I skimmed it. Everyone expected productivity to drop, right?
大概翻了翻。大家都以为生产效率会下降，对吧？
F
That's what I thought too, but it actually stayed about the same.
我也是这么想的，但实际上基本没变。
M
So what was the big finding?
那主要发现是什么？
F
The interesting part was about new hires. People who started their jobs remotely were far less likely to ask questions, and many of them left within a year.
有意思的是关于新员工的部分。远程入职的人很少提问，而且很多人一年内就离职了。
M
Huh. I'd have guessed experienced workers would struggle more, since they're used to the office.
嗯？我还以为习惯了办公室的老员工会更难适应。
F
Apparently not. They adapted fine. It's the newcomers who miss out on learning from colleagues.
看来不是。他们适应得很好。错过向同事学习机会的是新人。
q: According to the woman, what was the main finding of the study?
c: Productivity dropped when people worked remotely.
New employees who started remotely struggled more.
Experienced workers found it hard to adapt.
Remote workers asked more questions.
cz: 远程办公使生产效率下降。
远程入职的新员工更吃力。
有经验的员工难以适应。
ex: 女的说研究的有趣之处在于远程入职的新人很少提问、很多人一年内离职。生产效率基本没变，老员工适应良好，远程新人提问反而更少。

intro: A teacher is talking to her students.
lines: F
Good morning, everyone. Next Tuesday, we're going on a school trip to a farm.
大家早上好。下周二我们要去农场进行学校旅行。
F
We'll leave school by bus at eight thirty.
我们八点半坐大巴从学校出发。
F
At the farm, you'll feed the cows and pick strawberries.
在农场，你们会喂奶牛、摘草莓。
F
Please bring your lunch, a water bottle, and a hat, because it may be sunny.
请带上午饭、水壶和帽子，因为可能会很晒。
F
And don't forget to give this letter to your parents and bring it back by Friday.
还有，别忘了把这封信交给家长，周五前交回来。
q: What is the teacher mainly talking about?
c: How to take care of cows
Plans for a school trip
What to eat for lunch
A strawberry festival at school
ex: 老师介绍了出发时间、活动内容和要带的东西，主题是学校旅行的安排。喂奶牛、带午饭都只是其中的细节。

intro: A man is talking about his weekends.
lines: M
Every Sunday morning, I go to the park near my house.
每个星期天早上，我都去家附近的公园。
M
But I don't go there to run or play sports. I go there to pick up trash.
但我去那里不是跑步或运动，而是去捡垃圾。
M
About ten people from my neighborhood join me. We bring bags and gloves.
大约有十个邻居和我一起，我们带着袋子和手套。
M
After an hour, the park looks much cleaner.
一个小时后，公园就干净多了。
M
Then we have coffee together and chat. I've made a lot of new friends this way.
然后我们一起喝咖啡聊天。我就这样交了很多新朋友。
q: What is the man mainly talking about?
c: Running in the park on Sundays
Making coffee for his friends
Buying bags and gloves
Cleaning the park with his neighbors
ex: 男的讲的是每周日和邻居在公园捡垃圾的活动。他明确说不是去跑步，喝咖啡和袋子手套只是细节。

intro: Listen to part of a radio program.
lines: F
Many of us check our phones right before going to sleep. It feels relaxing, but it may be doing more harm than good.
很多人睡前都会看手机。这感觉很放松，但可能弊大于利。
F
The light from the screen tells our brain that it's still daytime, so it becomes harder to fall asleep.
屏幕的光会让大脑以为还是白天，于是更难入睡。
F
On top of that, reading messages or the news keeps our minds active when they should be slowing down.
此外，看消息或新闻会让大脑在该放慢的时候保持活跃。
F
Some people say they only watch funny videos, but even that delays sleep.
有人说自己只看搞笑视频，但那同样会推迟入睡。
F
So try putting your phone in another room an hour before bed. Read a paper book or listen to quiet music instead.
所以试试睡前一小时把手机放到别的房间，改为读纸质书或听轻音乐。
F
You may be surprised at how much better you feel the next morning.
第二天早上你会惊讶于自己感觉好了多少。
q: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
c: Why using a phone before bed is a bad idea
How to choose a good paper book
The benefits of watching funny videos
How to read the news more quickly
cz: 为什么睡前用手机不好
ex: 说话人解释了睡前看手机影响睡眠的原因，并建议睡前一小时远离手机。纸质书、搞笑视频、新闻都只是例子。

intro: A man is speaking to new students at a university.
lines: M
Welcome, everyone. I'd like to tell you about something many first-year students don't know about: the Writing Center.
欢迎大家。我想介绍一个很多新生都不知道的地方：写作中心。
M
It's on the second floor of the library, and it's completely free.
它在图书馆二楼，完全免费。
M
You can bring any kind of writing: an essay, a lab report, even a job application.
你可以带任何文稿来：论文、实验报告，甚至求职申请。
M
The tutors won't write it for you, but they'll help you organize your ideas and fix common mistakes.
辅导老师不会替你写，但会帮你理清思路、改正常见错误。
M
A lot of students only come the night before a deadline. Try to visit earlier, when you still have time to make real changes.
很多学生截止前一晚才来。尽量早点来，那时你还有时间真正修改。
M
You can make an appointment on the university website.
可以在学校网站上预约。
q: What is the speaker mainly talking about?
c: How to apply for a job on campus
The opening hours of the library
A service that helps students with their writing
How to write a good lab report
ex: 整段话都在介绍写作中心能为学生提供的帮助和使用方法。图书馆、实验报告、求职申请只是提到的细节。

intro: Listen to a news report.
lines: F
Starting next month, the city of Riverside will launch a new bike-sharing program.
从下个月起，河滨市将推出新的共享单车项目。
F
Five hundred bikes will be placed at sixty stations downtown and near major bus stops.
五百辆自行车将投放到市中心和主要公交站附近的六十个站点。
F
Users can rent a bike with a smartphone app, and the first thirty minutes of each ride will be free.
用户可以用手机应用租车，每次骑行前三十分钟免费。
F
City officials hope the program will reduce traffic in the city center and encourage people to exercise.
市政官员希望这个项目能减少市中心的交通拥堵，并鼓励人们锻炼身体。
F
If it proves popular, it will be expanded to other parts of the city next year.
如果反响好，明年将扩展到城市其他地区。
q: What is the news report mainly about?
c: Traffic problems near bus stops
A new smartphone app for buses
A new bike-sharing program in the city
Exercise programs for city workers
cz: 公交站附近的交通问题
城市新的共享单车项目
面向市政员工的健身项目
ex: 新闻介绍了共享单车项目的规模、使用方法和目的。公交站、手机应用、锻炼都是相关细节，不是主题。

intro: Listen to part of a lecture.
lines: M
Most of us assume that having more choices makes us happier. After all, more options mean a better chance of finding exactly what we want.
大多数人认为选择越多越幸福。毕竟选项越多，越有可能找到正合心意的东西。
M
But psychologists have found that beyond a certain point, extra choices can actually work against us.
但心理学家发现，超过一定程度后，多出来的选择反而对我们不利。
M
When faced with dozens of similar products, shoppers often take longer to decide, and some walk away without buying anything at all.
面对几十种相似的商品，顾客往往要花更长时间做决定，有些人干脆什么都不买就走了。
M
Even those who do choose tend to feel less satisfied, because they keep wondering whether one of the other options would have been better.
即使做出了选择的人也往往不太满意，因为他们总在想别的选项会不会更好。
M
Some businesses have responded by deliberately cutting the number of products they offer, and they've seen sales go up.
一些商家因此有意减少商品种类，结果销量反而上升了。
M
So the next time you feel stuck in front of a long menu, remember: the problem may not be you, but the number of options.
所以下次你对着长长的菜单犹豫不决时，记住：问题可能不在你，而在选项太多。
q: What is the main idea of the talk?
c: Too many choices can make decisions harder and less satisfying.
Businesses should offer more products to increase sales.
Shoppers are happier when they spend longer choosing.
Long menus help people find exactly what they want.
cz: 选择太多会让决定更难、满意度更低。
商家应提供更多商品来提高销量。
顾客花更多时间挑选会更开心。
长菜单帮助人们找到正想要的东西。
ex: 讲座的核心是选择过多反而让人难以决定、满意度下降。减少商品种类才使销量上升，其余选项都与讲座内容相反。

intro: Listen to part of a radio program.
lines: F
When we think about fighting summer heat in cities, we usually think of air conditioning.
说到应对城市夏季高温，我们通常会想到空调。
F
But air conditioners push hot air back outside, and they use huge amounts of electricity.
但空调会把热空气排到室外，而且耗电巨大。
F
A growing number of cities are turning to a much older solution: trees.
越来越多的城市开始转向一个古老得多的办法：种树。
F
Streets lined with trees can be several degrees cooler than bare ones, because leaves provide shade and release moisture into the air.
有行道树的街道比光秃秃的街道能凉快好几度，因为树叶能遮阴并向空气中释放水分。
F
Trees aren't a quick fix, of course. They take years to grow, and they need care and water.
当然，树木不是立竿见影的办法，它们要长好几年，还需要养护和浇水。
F
Still, many urban planners now argue that planting trees is one of the smartest long-term investments a city can make.
尽管如此，许多城市规划者认为，种树是城市最明智的长期投资之一。
q: What is the speaker's main point?
c: Air conditioners should be banned in cities.
Trees need too much water to be worth planting.
Older solutions are always better than new ones.
Planting trees is a valuable long-term way to cool cities.
cz: 城市应该禁止使用空调。
树需要太多水，不值得种。
种树是给城市降温的有价值的长期办法。
ex: 说话人虽然承认树木见效慢、需要养护，但结论是种树是城市降温的明智长期投资。并未主张禁止空调，“老办法”也只是对种树的形容。

intro: Listen to part of a talk.
lines: M
In an age when we can fill every spare minute with our phones, boredom has almost disappeared from daily life.
在这个能用手机填满每一分空闲的时代，无聊几乎从日常生活中消失了。
M
Waiting for a bus or standing in line used to mean simply doing nothing. Now we scroll.
过去等车或排队就意味着什么都不做，现在我们刷手机。
M
That might seem harmless, but researchers who study creativity are beginning to worry.
这看似无害，但研究创造力的学者开始担心了。
M
When our minds have nothing to focus on, they start to wander, and that wandering is often where new ideas come from.
当大脑没有可专注的东西时，就会开始漫游，而新点子往往就来自这种漫游。
M
In several experiments, people who had first done a dull task came up with more creative solutions afterward.
在几项实验中，先做了枯燥任务的人随后想出了更有创意的解决办法。
M
So rather than reaching for your phone the next time you're bored, let your mind drift for a while. It could be time well spent.
所以下次无聊时，别急着拿手机，让思绪飘一会儿吧，这段时间可能很值得。
q: What is the speaker mainly saying about boredom?
c: Phones have made people more bored than before.
It can help people become more creative.
Waiting in line is a waste of time.
Researchers have found ways to end it.
cz: 手机让人比以前更无聊。
它能帮助人们变得更有创造力。
研究者找到了消除它的方法。
ex: 说话人认为无聊时思绪漫游是新想法的来源，实验也表明它能促进创造力。手机其实让无聊几乎消失了，其他选项与内容不符。
